env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^direct struct$'
stdout '^fwd1 struct$'
stdout '^fwd1-other other$'
stdout '^fwd2 struct$'
stdout '^fixed struct$'
stdout '^self struct$'
logos run ./thin
stdout '^thin-fwd2 struct$'
logos test ./top/
logos eject -o out
exists out/main/main.go
exists out/thin/thin.go
exists out/top/top.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/main/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/thin/thin.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/top/top.go
! grep '_logos_ctimp' out/main/main.go
! grep '_logos_tparam' out/main/main.go
# Forwarded instantiations share one copy per type-argument list:
# Describe[probe] is reached directly and through two forwarding paths.
# SPEC 2.5: Describe[int], Describe[leaf.Fixed] and Wrap[int] name only
# types their defining packages can name, so eject prints them there.
grep -count=1 'func Describe_logosct' out/main/main.go
grep -count=1 'func Wrap_logosct' out/main/main.go
grep -count=1 'func Wrap2_logosct' out/main/main.go
grep -count=1 'func WrapFixed_logosct' out/main/main.go

cd out
go run ./main
stdout '^direct struct$'
stdout '^fwd1 struct$'
stdout '^fwd1-other other$'
stdout '^fwd2 struct$'
stdout '^fixed struct$'
stdout '^self struct$'
go run ./thin
stdout '^thin-fwd2 struct$'
go test -count=1 ./top/
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/fwdtest

go 1.27

-- w/leaf/leaf.lgo --
package leaf

import "comptime"

type Fixed struct {
	Name string
}

func Describe[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else {
		return "other"
	}
}

-- w/mid/mid.lgo --
package mid

import (
	"comptime"

	"example.com/fwdtest/leaf"
)

func Wrap[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		s := leaf.Describe[T]()
		return s
	} else {
		s := leaf.Describe[T]()
		return s
	}
}

func WrapFixed[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		s := leaf.Describe[leaf.Fixed]()
		return s
	} else {
		s := leaf.Describe[leaf.Fixed]()
		return s
	}
}

-- w/top/top.lgo --
package top

import (
	"comptime"

	"example.com/fwdtest/mid"
)
func Wrap2[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return mid.Wrap[T]()
	} else {
		return mid.Wrap[T]()
	}
}

type inner struct {
	Value int
}

func SelfProbe() string {
	return Wrap2[inner]()
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fwdtest/leaf"
	"example.com/fwdtest/mid"
	"example.com/fwdtest/top"
)

type probe struct {
	Name string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("direct", leaf.Describe[probe]())
	fmt.Println("fwd1", mid.Wrap[probe]())
	fmt.Println("fwd1-other", mid.Wrap[int]())
	fmt.Println("fwd2", top.Wrap2[probe]())
	fmt.Println("fixed", mid.WrapFixed[probe]())
	fmt.Println("self", top.SelfProbe())
}

-- w/thin/thin.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fwdtest/top"
)

type probe struct {
	Name string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("thin-fwd2", top.Wrap2[probe]())
}

-- w/top/wrap_x_test.lgo --
package top_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/fwdtest/top"
)

type probe struct {
	Name string
}

func TestWrap2External(t *testing.T) {
	if got := top.Wrap2[probe](); got != "struct" {
		t.Fatalf("Wrap2 = %q, want struct", got)
	}
	if got := top.Wrap2[int](); got != "other" {
		t.Fatalf("Wrap2[int] = %q, want other", got)
	}
}
